sourceProvenance.referenceRole: Silhouette reference only; authored mesh states no source geometry, textures, logos or labels carried forward.

garmentTypeAndCoverage.observation: All four actual views read as a standalone pair of trousers; no mannequin or body is visible.

silhouetteAndVolume.observation: Reads as full-length straight-leg cargo trousers with a continuous seat and two legs. Broad volume changes are visible around the seat, thighs and knees; the silhouette remains coherent across front, back, side and oblique views.

cargoPockets.observation: Two thigh cargo patch pockets are identifiable in front and oblique views and remain attached to the leg surface in side view. Their raised edges and top flap seams are visible; no detached pocket is apparent.

frontButtonAndFly.observation: A front button and centered fly/placket seam are identifiable in front and oblique views. The zipper hardware is covered by the fly as expected for this construction.

beltLoops.observation: The front and back show a continuous waistband with no distinct loop straps crossing over it. No loops can be identified at the side or oblique angle either.

hemDrawcords.observation: Hem channels and cuff seams are visible, but no cord ends, exits or hanging drawstrings are identifiable at either hem in front, back, side or oblique views.

findings.observation: No distinct belt loops are visible crossing the waistband in any angle.
findings.expected: Add clearly attached belt loops spaced around the waistband, readable from front and oblique views.

findings.observation: The cuffs show channel/seam bands, but no drawcord ends or visible cord exits.
findings.expected: Make the drawcords at both hems visibly identifiable while keeping them attached to the cuff channels.

summary: QA độc lập trả phom xám ATEL-41/v2 cho một correction tập trung. Silhouette quần cargo và hai túi đùi đọc được; button/fly seam có thể nhận ra, không mannequin. Hai chi tiết bắt buộc chưa đọc được trong ảnh: đỉa thắt lưng và dây rút ở cả hai gấu. Chưa duyệt surface; Designer sửa hình học/chi tiết theo hai vùng được dẫn chứng rồi handoff revision mới qua flow.
